title: Interlacing for zeros of the Serre derivative of Eisenstein series
summary: In 1970, Rankin and Swinnerton-Dyer showed that the non-elliptic zeros of Eisenstein series $E_k$ in the fundamental domain all lie on the lower arc $\{ e^{iθ}: \fracπ{2} k$. Second, we classify precisely when the zeros of $\vartheta_\ell(E_\ell)$ (standard) interlace with the zeros of $\vartheta_k(E_k)$ on the lower arc. Third, we show that the zeros of $\vartheta_k(E_k)$ always (standard) interlace with the zeros of $E_{k+2}$ on the lower arc.
